name: Ripple Grid
description: WebGL2 shader background of a thin grid (lines, dots or crosses) that bends and glows with ripple waves from auto timers, pointer movement and clicks, with optional perspective tilt.
contents: Full-size container div with an absolutely positioned WebGL canvas
Fragment shader drawing the grid, ripple distortion, glow, pointer highlight and edge fade
behavior: Intro reveal expands the grid outward from the center over 1.6 seconds
Auto ripples spawn from the center or random spots at a set interval
Pointer movement spawns small ripples and adds a glow near the cursor
Click or tap adds a stronger ripple
Rendering pauses when offscreen, tab hidden, or paused prop is set, and stops animating with reduced motion
Canvas resizes with the container and caps pixel ratio at 2
editableByProps: Grid style, color, cell size, line width, glow, rotation and perspective tilt
Ripple strength, speed, size, auto mode and interval
Pointer and click interaction, intro, edge fade, opacity, light mode, pause
Pixel ratio and container className or extra div attributes

needsCodeEdit.change: Raise the number of simultaneous ripples

needsCodeEdit.where: render function (Math.exp(-age * 0.55)) and lifetime in frame function

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined height
Listens to pointer events on window, so interaction works even when other content covers it
Canvas is aria-hidden and decorative only
Grid is drawn as a faint overlay with low alpha, best on dark backgrounds unless lightMode is on
Fills any container size and resizes with it, usable on mobile, with hover glow absent on touch

options.useWhen: Hero of a SaaS or developer product wanting a clean technical blueprint backdrop
Minimal landing page needing a soft, subtle texture behind text

options.look: Small plus marks at grid intersections
options.useWhen: Design or engineering portfolio wanting a drafting-paper feel
